beats.text: Hi, I'm Lexi. This is LexAI Portal: your law firm's workspace, with an AI that asks before it acts.
Each morning, the dashboard and your AI daily briefing show what needs you today.
Every case has its own workspace, with documents, a timeline, tasks and hearings.
Ask a question in plain words. The AI answers only from your documents, and shows the source file.
If the answer isn't there, it says so.

scenes.title: It does the work, you approve

beats.text: Or tell the assistant: upload this file for this case, and email it to the client.
It stops, and asks before filing the document.
And again, before sending the email. Nothing happens until you approve.
Waiting actions are also listed on the Approvals page.

scenes.title: New judgments, matched to your cases

beats.text: Legal Intelligence matches new eCourts judgments to your cases, and explains why.
Compare shows what's the same, and what's different. It's a reading aid, never a prediction.
Tasks, calendars and reminders keep the whole team on schedule.
Admins decide, tool by tool: always allow, ask first, or blocked.
And every action is saved in an audit log that can't be edited.
Four simple rules.
Answers come from your documents.
No legal advice.
It can't give itself permission.
And every change waits for a person.
beats.point: Every change waits for a person

beats.text: To go live, connect an AI model, eCourts and email in Settings.
Thanks for watching!
